description: React component for managing email backup preferences in a web application. It includes loading and updating email backup frequency settings, toggling email notifications for failed backups, and rendering UI elements such as dropdowns and switches.

methods.name: loadEmailFrequencySetting
methods.description: Async function to load user email backup settings and initialize component state.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Async function to update a user setting through the application API.

methods.name: updateEmailFrequency
methods.description: Updates the email backup frequency setting.

methods.name: toggleMuteFailedBackupEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute option for failed email backup notifications.

methods.name: handleEmailFrequencyChange
methods.description: Handles change in email frequency dropdown selection, triggering setting update.
